blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
This work presents a novel application of Earth Observation (EO) embeddings for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) from the perspective of the geospatial foundation model TerraMind. By operating directly on compressed latent-space representations rather than on the original Sentinel-1 imagery, this approach directly addresses the data gravity bottleneck that increasingly constrains operational EO processing, in line with the objectives of the Embed2Scale project. In particular, linear and non-linear probing of compressed embeddings, latent space representations of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, is used to detect, localise, and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 GRD images. Vessel detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.95, while vessel localisation has a median error of around 300 m for vessels longer than 100 m, and vessel AIS type-code classification achieves 62% accuracy for the majority classes. The latter, however, is highly correlated with vessel length. These results reveal both the potential and current limitations of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) when applied to fine-grained MDA understanding in real-world scenarios.
  Additionally, a new maritime remote sensing dataset is released, pairing about 2,000 Sentinel-1 images with temporally aligned AIS signals from commercial vessels. Through manual inspection, each candidate sample was verified for bounding-box quality and for consistency between the AIS-reported vessel length and the observed vessel extent, cross-checking vessel identity and location against publicly available vessel records and, where available, photographs. The dataset was made ready for use with the NeuCo-Bench neural compression benchmark framework, publicly available on HuggingFace through https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship-downstream .
blocks.zh:
这项工作从地理空间基础模型TerraMind的视角,介绍了对地观测嵌入海洋领域认识的新应用。 通过直接使用压缩后的潜在空间表示而不是原始的Sentinel-1图像,这种方法直接解决了数据引力瓶颈,这种瓶颈日益限制了EO业务处理,符合Embed2规模项目的目标。 特别是,对压缩嵌入物进行线性和非线性探测,合成孔径雷达(SAR)图像的潜在空间表示,用于从Sentinel-1 GRD图像中探测、定位和定性容器。 船只探测达到ROC-AUC为0.95,而船只定位在100米以上船只的中位误差为300米左右,船只AIS型号分类在大多数类别达到62%的准确度。 然而,后者与船只长度密切相关。 这些结果揭示了地理空间基础模型(GeoFMs)在适用于现实世界情景中精细的MDA理解时的潜在和目前局限性.
此外,还发布了一个新的海洋遥感数据集,将大约2 000个哨兵一号图像与商业船只的时空对齐的AIS信号相配对。 通过人工检查,对每个候选样品进行了核查,以了解装订箱的质量,以及所报告船舶长度与所观察船舶范围的一致性,对照公开的船舶记录核对船舶身份和位置,并在有照片的情况下核对照片。 该数据集已准备就绪,可使用NeuCo-Bench神经压缩基准框架,可通过https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship-下游在HuggingFace上公开查阅。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 1.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 1.1 动机

blocks.en: The Copernicus programme generates over 22 terabytes of data per day [ 10 ] , a volume that keeps growing and increasingly limits how quickly Earth Observation (EO) data can be transferred, stored, and processed. This bottleneck, often referred to as data gravity , is especially relevant for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA), where the value of a detection depends on low-latency processing. Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) offer a potential way to ease this bottleneck by encoding EO imagery into compact latent-space representations that can be reused for downstream analysis. This study, developed within the Horizon Europe-funded Embed2Scale project, investigates whether core MDA tasks such as vessel detection, localisation, and characterisation can be performed directly from these representations, without sacrificing accuracy.
blocks.zh: 哥白尼方案每天生成超过22个千兆字节的数据[10],这个量不断增长并日益限制地球观测数据能够传送、储存和处理的速度。 这一瓶颈通常被称为数据引力,与海洋领域认识(MDA)特别相关,因为探测值取决于低纬度处理。 地理空间基础模型(GeoFMs)为缓解这一瓶颈提供了一种可能的途径,将EO图像编码为可再用于下游分析的紧凑的潜在空间表示。 这项研究是在地平线欧洲资助的Embed2规模项目范围内进行的,它调查诸如船只探测、定位和特性化等核心MDA任务是否能够直接从这些表述中完成,而不牺牲准确性。

blocks.en: 1.2 State-of-the-Art in Maritime Domain Awareness
blocks.zh: 1.2 海洋领域知识水平

blocks.en: MDA has traditionally relied on the Automatic Identification System (AIS), which broadcasts vessel identity and position but is not mandatory for all vessels and can be deactivated or spoofed [ 2 ] . Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) complements AIS by providing independent, all-weather, day-and-night observations, with Sentinel-1’s open access and short revisit time making it the standard source for operational ship detection [ 19 ] . Detection methods have evolved from statistical approaches such as Constant False Alarm Rate (CFAR) to deep learning-based object detectors, including YOLO-family architectures, which have improved both detection and classification accuracy [ 12 , 20 ] ; prior work applied YOLOv8 to an AIS-labelled Sentinel-1 dataset for this purpose [ 3 ] . More recently, GeoFMs such as TerraMind [ 15 ] have emerged as an alternative way to represent EO data, but their use in the maritime domain has so far been limited to feature extraction ahead of decoding or full-resolution processing. Whether MDA tasks can be performed directly within the compressed latent space itself remains largely unexplored, and is the gap this study addresses. Besides, a related limitation is the scarcity of high-quality, manually verified datasets pairing SAR imagery with AIS ground truth: existing AIS-SAR alignments are typically weakly supervised [ 14 , 13 ] and rarely cross-checked against independent vessel records, which constrains both the training and the evaluation of vessel-related EO tasks. This study also addresses this gap by releasing a manually verified maritime benchmark dataset.
blocks.zh: MDA传统上依靠自动识别系统(AIS),该系统广播船只的身份和位置,但并非对所有船只都是强制性的,可以停用或偷取[2]. 合成孔径雷达(SAR)通过提供独立、全天候、昼夜观测来补充AIS,哨兵1号的开放访问和短暂的再访时间使其成为业务船舶探测的标准来源[19]。 检测方法从常有假警报率(CFAR)等统计方法演变为深层学习对象探测器,包括YOLO-家族结构,这些方法提高了检测和分类精度[12,20];先前的工作将YOLOv8应用到一个为此贴有AIS标签的Sentinel-1数据集[3]. 最近,TerraMind[15]等地缘FM作为代表EO数据的一种替代方法而出现,但迄今为止,它们在海洋领域的使用仅限于在解码或全分辨率处理之前进行特征提取. MDA任务能否直接在压缩后的潜在空间内完成,基本上仍未加以探讨,而本研究所弥补的空白也是如此。 此外,一个相关的限制是缺乏将搜索和救援系统图像与AIS地面真实性相配对的高质量、人工核实的数据集:现有的AIS-SAR对接通常监督不力[14、13],很少与独立的船舶记录相核对,这限制了与船舶有关的EO任务的培训和评价。 这项研究还通过发布经人工核实的海洋基准数据集来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: 1.3 Geospatial Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 1.3 地理空间基金会模式

blocks.en: The vast scale and diversity of EO archives position them as a promising domain for foundation models [ 6 ] . These are well suited to settings where high-quality labelled data are scarce but large collections of unlabelled data are available. GeoFMs are therefore pretrained through self-supervision on large EO datasets to learn general representations from unlabelled imagery [ 26 , 24 , 23 ] . These representations can then support a wide range of downstream tasks using small labelled datasets and task-specific decoders [ 17 , 25 ] . A common adaptation approach is end-to-end fine-tuning, where the backbone and a task-specific decoder are optimised jointly for each task. However, this requires repeated access to the raw imagery and repeated computation through the large backbone. A more efficient paradigm treats the GeoFM as a frozen feature extractor and reuses its intermediate latent-space representations as task-agnostic embeddings [ 16 , 11 , 8 ] . Each input scene is encoded once, after which lightweight models operate on the fixed representations. This reduces adaptation costs and enables compact representation stores, decentralised use, and similarity search at scale [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: EO档案的庞大规模和多样性将它们定位为基础模型的一个有希望的领域[6]. 这些都非常适合高质量的标签数据稀少但有大量无标签数据的设置。 因此,GeoFM在大型EO数据集上通过自我监督进行预先训练,从无标签的图像中学习一般表述[26,24,23]. 然后,这些表述可以使用小的标签数据集和特定任务解码器支持广泛的下游任务[17,25]. 一个共同的适应方式是端到端微调,其中主干线和任务特定的解码器为每项任务共同优化. 然而,这需要反复取用原始图像,并通过大型骨干重复计算。 一个更有效率的范式将GeoFM作为冷冻特性提取器,并将其中间潜在-空间表示再利用为任务不可知的嵌入 [16, 11, 8]. 每个输入场景被编码一次,之后轻量级模型在固定的表示上运行. 这降低了适应费用,并使得能够建立紧凑的表示库、分散使用和规模相近的搜索[21]。

blocks.en: 1.4 Probing the Latent Space
blocks.zh: 1.4 探索后天空间

blocks.en: When using a GeoFM as a frozen encoder, downstream performance depends on what information its latent-space representations retain and how easily it can be extracted for a given task. Probing provides a direct and low-cost way to assess this by training lightweight models on frozen representations [ 1 , 4 , 21 ] . Comparing linear and shallow non-linear probes further shows whether task-relevant information is directly accessible or requires a more expressive prediction model. In this work, latent-space representations generated by TerraMind from Sentinel-1 imagery [ 15 ] are probed to assess how well they capture vessel presence, type, size, and position.
blocks.zh: 在使用GeoFM作为被冷冻的编码器时,下游的性能取决于其潜在的空间表示保留哪些信息,以及它在多大程度上可以被提取用于特定任务. 通过对轻量级模型进行关于被冻结的表述的培训[1、4、21],试探提供了一种直接和低成本的评估方法。 比较线性和浅非线性探测器可以进一步显示与任务有关的信息是否可直接取用,或者需要更能表达的预测模型. 在这项工作中,对TerraMind从Sentinel-1图像[15]生成的潜在空间表示进行了探测,以评估它们如何很好地捕捉船只的存在、类型、大小和位置。

blocks.zh: 2个数据集

blocks.en: The Sentinel-1 imagery is not processed directly in the downstream experiments. Instead, latent-space representations are extracted using TerraMind, a GeoFM jointly developed by IBM and ESA [ 15 ] . These representations are matched with temporally aligned AIS-derived labels, as described in Section 3.1 , to construct a balanced, weakly labelled dataset. Compared with the original Sentinel-1 imagery, the latent representations reduce the data volume by a factor between 100 and 1000 depending on the model used.
blocks.zh: 哨兵一号图像在下游实验中不直接处理. 相反,利用TerraMind提取出潜在的空间表示,TerraMind是一种由IBM和欧空局联合开发的GeoFM[15]。 如第3.1节所描述,这些表示与暂时一致的AIS出自的标签相匹配,以构建一个平衡、标签薄弱的数据集。 与原始的Sentinel-1图像相比,潜在表示值根据所使用的模型将数据量减少100到1000个系数.

blocks.en: This large-scale dataset is used for the vessel detection experiments described in Section 4.1 . For the vessel characterisation and localisation experiments, a smaller, manually verified subset is additionally constructed, as detailed in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 该大型数据集用于第4.1节所描述的船舶探测实验. 如第3.2节所详述的,在容器特性和定位试验方面,还额外建造了一个较小的、人工核查的子集。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: In the following, the process of utilising the openly available data introduced in Section 2 is detailed for a pipeline that curates (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ) and embeds (Section 3.3 ) them for (non-)linear probing (Section 3.4 ) to detect and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 imagery.
blocks.zh: 在下文中,详细介绍了利用第2节中公开提供的数据的过程,用于探测(非)线性探测(第3.4节)Sentinel-1图象并给船只定性的管道(第3.1和3.2节)和嵌入(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 AIS–Sentinel-1 Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.1 AIS-Sentinel-1对齐

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Example 264x264 pixel S1 greyscale image of the VV polarisation with a single vessel and a subset of metadata.
blocks.zh: 图1:示例264x264像素 S1 灰度图像 VV 极化,并有单个容器和元数据子集.

blocks.en: Vessel labels were derived from AIS records and aligned with Sentinel-1 acquisitions following the same procedure as our previous study [ 3 ] , adapted here to operate at embedding rather than pixel level: • Temporal matching: only the AIS record closest in time, up to 20 minutes, to each Sentinel-1 acquisition was retained per vessel (MMSI). • Spatial refinement: reported positions were adjusted to the nearest peak in VV/VH backscatter within a 500 m buffer, to correct for drift between the AIS report and the acquisition time. Additionally, a minimum offshore buffer of 1 km was applied to prevent misclassification with terrestrial features. • Patch-to-embedding assignment: refined positions and AIS-derived vessel length were used to assign each vessel to its corresponding Sentinel-1 patch, and therefore to the matching TerraMind embedding. • Negative sampling: an equal number of embeddings from patches with no AIS-confirmed vessel were sampled from the same scenes, to build a balanced dataset without biasing the negative class toward different sea or coastal conditions. As in our prior work [ 3 ] , this procedure is weakly supervised: vessels not broadcasting AIS at the time of acquisition are inevitably included in the negative class, a known limitation of AIS–SAR alignment [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 船舶标签取自AIS记录,与Sentinel-1的购置一致,遵循与我们先前研究相同的程序[3],在此调整,以嵌入而非像素水平运作: 时间相匹配:每艘船舶只保留AIS最及时、最接近每艘Sentinel-1的购置记录(MMSI)。 • 空间改进:报告位置被调整到500米缓冲范围内VVV/VH回放中最接近的峰值,以纠正AIS报告和获取时间之间的漂移。 此外,采用了1公里的最小海上缓冲器,以防止带有陆地特征的分级错误。 • 补丁-嵌入式任务:使用精细的姿势和人工智能系统衍生出的船只长度,将每艘船只划入相应的哨兵一号补丁,从而划入相匹配的TerraMind嵌入。 • 负采样:从没有AIS确认船的补丁上取出相同数量的嵌入物从同一场景采样,以建立一个平衡的数据集,同时不对不同的海洋或沿海条件的负类进行偏差。 与我们以前的工作[3]一样,这一程序受到薄弱的监督:购置时没有广播AIS的船舶不可避免地被列入负级,这是众所周知的AIS-SAR对接的限制[3]。

blocks.en: Temporal matching: only the AIS record closest in time, up to 20 minutes, to each Sentinel-1 acquisition was retained per vessel (MMSI).
blocks.zh: 时间匹配:每艘船只保留最接近每艘哨兵一号的AIS记录,最多20分钟。

blocks.en: Spatial refinement: reported positions were adjusted to the nearest peak in VV/VH backscatter within a 500 m buffer, to correct for drift between the AIS report and the acquisition time. Additionally, a minimum offshore buffer of 1 km was applied to prevent misclassification with terrestrial features.
blocks.zh: 空间改进:报告位置被调整到500米缓冲范围内VV/VH回放中最接近的峰值,以纠正AIS报告和获取时间之间的漂移. 此外,采用了1公里的最小海上缓冲器,以防止带有陆地特征的分级错误。

blocks.en: Patch-to-embedding assignment: refined positions and AIS-derived vessel length were used to assign each vessel to its corresponding Sentinel-1 patch, and therefore to the matching TerraMind embedding.
blocks.zh: 补丁-嵌入式任务:利用精细的姿势和AIS衍生出的船只长度,将每艘船只分配到相应的哨兵一号补丁上,从而分配到相匹配的TerraMind嵌入上.

blocks.en: Negative sampling: an equal number of embeddings from patches with no AIS-confirmed vessel were sampled from the same scenes, to build a balanced dataset without biasing the negative class toward different sea or coastal conditions.
blocks.zh: 负面取样:从同一场景中取样的嵌入物数量相同,没有经过AIS确认的容器,以便建立一个平衡的数据集,同时不偏向不同的海洋或沿海情况。

blocks.en: 3.2 Constructing a High-Quality Downstream Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.2 构建高质量的下游数据集

blocks.en: To construct a reliable downstream dataset for ship localisation benchmarking, S1 GRD imagery was combined with vessel information derived from AIS records, followed by an extensive manual verification procedure. The goal was to retain only image crops with a single, clearly identifiable vessel and a trustworthy spatial association between the AIS record and the S1 observation.
blocks.zh: 为了构建一套可靠的下游数据集,用于船舶定位基准,S1 GRD图像与从人工识别系统记录中获取的船舶信息相结合,然后是广泛的人工核查程序。 目的是只保留图像作物,只保留一个可明确识别的单一容器,并在AIS记录和S1观测之间建立可信赖的空间联系。

blocks.en: The selection started from a curated set of vessels close to the U.S. coast and its inland river streams as detailed in Section 3.1 . For each vessel, the available metadata included geographic position, timestamp, vessel dimensions, and other AIS-derived attributes. The AIS position served as the anchor for locating the corresponding vessel in the S1 imagery.
blocks.zh: 如第3.1节所详述的,选择从离美国海岸及其内陆河流相近的一组船只开始。 对每艘船舶而言,现有的元数据包括地理位置、时间戳、船只尺寸和其他AIS衍生属性。 AIS位置是将相应船只定位在S1图像中的锚地。

blocks.en: To build the downstream dataset, 3,250 vessels were first randomly sampled from the aligned S1–AIS dataset. For each sampled vessel, four image crops of size 264 × 264 264\times 264 pixels were drawn at random, with a 30 pixel (300 m) buffer such that the vessel centre point was constrained to lie within the 204 × 204 204\times 204 most central pixels of each crop. This yielded a total of 13,000 candidate crops.
blocks.zh: 为了建立下游数据集,首先从对齐的S1-AIS数据集中随机抽取了3,250艘船只. 对于每个被取样的容器,随机抽取出4个尺寸为264×264相264相像素的图像作物,并有30相像素(300米)的缓冲器,使容器中心点被限制在204相204相204相204相204相204相大多数中央像素范围内. 这共产生了13 000个候选作物。

blocks.en: The number of vessels present in all 13,000 crops was manually counted. Crops containing multiple vessels were removed from further consideration. For the remaining crops with a single vessel, approximately 2,500 crops were manually inspected. The manual verification procedure focused on several aspects of quality control: • Bounding-box quality. • Consistency between the AIS-provided vessel length and the observed vessel extent in the image. • Dataset-level matching status, with the following categories marked: – vessel location in S1 differing from the AIS data, – multiple vessels visible in the S1 image, – missing AIS information, – vessel size mismatch, – missing vessel photograph for visual inspection of ship type or missing link to the vessel location in https://www.vesselfinder.com . Crops with only this issue are kept in the final dataset.
blocks.zh: 所有13 000个作物中的船只数量都是人工统计的。 含有多艘船只的作物被不再考虑。 仅用一艘船就余下作物进行了大约2 500个人工检查。 人工核查程序侧重于质量控制的几个方面: 装订箱质量; 自动识别系统提供的船舶长度与所观察的船舶成像范围的一致性。 • 数据集级匹配状态,标记如下类别:- S1中船只位置不同于AIS数据;- S1图像中可见多艘船;- 缺少AIS信息;- 船只尺寸不匹配;- 缺少船只相片,用于目视检查船只类型或与船只位置的缺失链接,见https://www.vesselfinder.com. 仅涉及这个问题的作物保留在最后的数据集中。

blocks.en: Bounding-box quality.
blocks.zh: 破碎的盒子质量。

blocks.en: Consistency between the AIS-provided vessel length and the observed vessel extent in the image.
blocks.zh: 由AIS提供的船只长度与图像中观测到的船只范围的一致性。

blocks.en: The final curated dataset prioritises label reliability over raw sample count by combining automatic AIS alignment, crop-level vessel counting, and manual inspection of candidate samples.
blocks.zh: 最终整理的数据集将标签的可靠性置于原始样本数之上,将自动AIS对接、作物级船只计数和人工检查候选样本结合起来。

blocks.en: The dataset is made publicly available 2 2 2 Available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship to extend the downstream tasks for NeuCo-Bench [ 21 ] , a benchmarking framework designed to evaluate how effectively compact, fixed-size embeddings preserve information for downstream tasks. The vessel locations and metadata originate from publicly available AIS data provided by the U.S. Marine Cadastre and cover twelve major U.S. ports. While most samples depict open water, the dataset also contains scenes intersecting land and rivers.
blocks.zh: 数据集公布在https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship上,以延长NeuCo-Bench的下游任务[21],这个基准框架旨在评价如何有效地为下游任务保存信息。 船舶位置和元数据取自美国海洋地籍局提供的公开AIS数据,涵盖美国12个主要港口。 虽然大多数样本描绘了开阔的水面,但数据集中也包含相交地和河流的场景.

blocks.en: Each S1 sample is provided as a 264 × 264 264\times 264 pixel GeoTIFF containing the corresponding VV and VH polarisations of the S1 GRD product. The accompanying metadata provide the S1 acquisition time and image location as well as vessel-specific information, including IMO and MMSI identifiers, vessel type and name, dimensions, draft, cargo type, geographic coordinates, bounding-box geometry, and the pixel coordinates ( x ship , y ship ) (x_{\mathrm{ship}},y_{\mathrm{ship}}) of the verified ship centre.
blocks.zh: 每个S1样本以264×264264\times264像素GeoTIFF提供,包含对应的S1 GRD产品的VV和VH极化. 附带的元数据提供了S1的获取时间和图像位置以及具体船只的信息,包括海事组织和MSI的识别标志、船只类型和名称、尺寸、草稿、货物类型、地理坐标、边框几何,以及经核实的船舶中心的像素坐标(x ship, y_{\mathrm{ship})。

blocks.en: Labels compatible with NeuCo-Bench are provided in addition to the metadata. Specifically, each S1 datacube is accompanied by a structured label describing the single verified vessel contained in the image. The primary labels for the downstream localisation task are the pixel coordinates ( x ship , y ship ) (x_{\mathrm{ship}},y_{\mathrm{ship}}) , which specify the centre of the vessel in the 264 × 264 264\times 264 pixel image, measured relative to the upper-left corner. In addition, the label contains the geographic ship position ( longitude , latitude ) (\mathrm{longitude},\mathrm{latitude}) and a WKT polygon ( geometry ) describing the vessel bounding box in geographic coordinates.
blocks.zh: 除了元数据外,还提供了与NeuCo-Bench兼容的标签. 具体地说,每个S1数据立方体都有一个结构化的标签来描述图像中包含的被验证的单个容器. 下游本地化任务的主要标签是像素坐标 (x ship, y ship (x_{\mathrm{ship}},y_{\ mathrm{ship}})),该坐标在264×264相264相264相位相上左角相上下角相上下相上下相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相下相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相上相 此外,标签中还包含地理船只位置(经度,纬度)(\mathrm{经度},\mathrm{纬度})和一个在地理坐标上描述容器边框的WKT多边形(几何).

blocks.en: The labels further retain the AIS-derived vessel information used during dataset construction and verification. This includes the vessel’s IMO and MMSI identifiers, vessel type and name, length, width, draft, and cargo type. Each observation is also associated with the Unix timestamp of the S1 acquisition ( timestamp_s1 ), as well as location and time identifiers ( loc_id and time_id ). Finally, file_name provides the link between a metadata record and its corresponding remote-sensing datacube. Thus, while the downstream localisation target can be represented compactly by ( x ship , y ship ) (x_{\mathrm{ship}},y_{\mathrm{ship}}) , the released labels retain the geographic bounding box and vessel metadata to facilitate additional analyses and alternative downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 这些标签还保留了数据集构建和核查中使用的AIS衍生船只信息。 这包括该船的海事组织和海运事务局的识别资料、船只类型和名称、长度、宽度、发货和货物类型。 每个观测也与S1收购的Unix时间戳(timtamp_s1)以及位置和时间识别符(loc_id和tim-id.)有关. 最后,file_name提供了元数据记录与其相应的遥感数据立方体之间的联系. 因此,虽然下游本地化目标可以被 (x ship, y ship (x) mathrm{ship}}, y_{\ mathrm{ship}}) 紧凑地表示,但发布的标签保留了地理界框和船只元数据,以便于进行额外的分析和替代下游任务.

blocks.en: Compatibility with SSL4EO-S12-downstream and NeuCo-Bench . For compatibility with the SSL4EO-S12 downstream data format, the release further contains optional colocated and coprojected Sentinel-2 L1C and L2A datacubes with the same spatial dimensions and band structure as the corresponding SSL4EO-S12 modalities. These supplementary S2 observations were deliberately selected to have 100% cloud cover, ensuring that the ship-localisation information relevant to the downstream task must be preserved from S1 rather than inferred from optical imagery. Invisibility of the ship in the optical Sentinel-2 imagery was carefully checked by the manual ship annotation procedure. The cloudy images correspond to actual clouds at the ship’s geolocation for all four seasons of the year in which the ship was captured by Sentinel-1. Within the SSL4EO-S12 data loader, the same S1 observation is replicated across all four S2 seasons. The complete release of the SSL4EO-S12-downstream task ship has a size of approximately 14 GB, of which the S1 imagery accounts for approximately 2.3 GB.
blocks.zh: 与SSL4EO-S12下游和NeuCo-Bench的兼容性. 对于与SSL4EO-S12下游数据格式的相容性,该发布还包含可选的同地定位并共同投影的Sentinel-2 L1C和L2A数据立方体,其空间尺寸和波段结构与相应的SSL4EO-S12模式相同. 这些补充的S2观测被有意选取为100%的云层覆盖,确保了与下游任务相关的船舶定位信息必须从S1中保存,而不是从光学图像中推断出. 船舶在光学"哨兵-2"图像中的隐形性经过了人工船舶注释程序的仔细检查. 云层图像对应了舰只被哨兵一号俘获的当年所有四个赛季在舰只地理位置上的实际云层. 在SSL4EO-S12数据加载器内,同样的S1观测被复制到所有四个S2赛季. SSL4EO-S12-下游任务舰的完全放出体积约为14GB,其中S1图像约占2.3GB.

blocks.en: 3.3 Embedding Generation with TerraMind
blocks.zh: 3.3 用地平线嵌入生成器

blocks.en: Latent representations of the Sentinel-1 input images are obtained using TerraMind [ 15 ] , a multimodal GeoFM pretrained on the global TerraMesh corpus [ 5 ] , which includes co-aligned Sentinel-1 imagery. Two complementary encoding methods are used: (i) the encoder of the modality-specific Sentinel-1 tokenizer and (ii) the TerraMind encoder . Both operate on the same Sentinel-1 input, allowing the value of the multimodal pretraining relative to the standalone Sentinel-1 tokenizer representation to be assessed. All encoders are kept frozen. For both encoding methods, the 264 × 264 264\times 264 Sentinel-1 GRD input samples are rescaled to TerraMind’s pretraining input resolution of 224 × 224 224\times 224 . Each image is then partitioned into 14 × 14 = 196 14\times 14=196 non-overlapping 16 × 16 16\times 16 patches. The channels are standardised using the TerraMesh Sentinel-1 GRD pretraining statistics.
blocks.zh: 利用TerraMind[15]获得哨兵1号输入图像的Latent表示,这是全球TerraMeshebureum上预先训练的多式地球调频图象[5],其中包括了协同哨兵1号图像。 使用了两种互补编码方法:(一) 特定模式Sentinel-1的编码器和(二) TerraMind编码器。 两者都在同一Sentinel-1输入上运行,从而可以评估相对于独立的Sentinel-1象征性表示器的多式预训值. 所有编码器都被冻结了 对于这两种编码方法,264×264\times 264 Sentinel-1 GRD输入样本被重新缩放到TerraMind224×224\times 224的预训输入分辨率. 然后将每个图像分入14×14=196 14\times 14=196 不重叠 16×16 16\times 16补丁. 频道采用TerraMesh Sentinel-1GRD预训统计实现标准化.

blocks.en: Sentinel-1 tokenizer embeddings As a unimodal baseline, representations are extracted from the encoder of TerraMind’s Sentinel-1 GRD tokenizer. The tokenizer follows a quantised-autoencoder design. A ViT encoder maps each 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixel patch to a 5 5 -dimensional latent vector. Finite-scalar quantisation discretises this vector to one of 15,360 15{,}360 possible codewords. A diffusion decoder reconstructs the image from the resulting discrete tokens. For each scene, the 196 196 quantised latent vectors form a 5 × 14 × 14 5\times 14\times 14 tensor, which is flattened before use in downstream analyses. Relative to the original input, this gives a compression factor of approximately 102 × 102\times when storing the quantised latent values and 1024 × 1024\times when storing the one 16-bit token index per patch. Each token index uniquely identifies its corresponding quantised latent vector.
blocks.zh: Sentinel-1 标记器嵌入 作为单一模式的基线,从TerraMind的Sentinel-1 GRD活化剂的编码器中提取出代表物。 标致器遵循了被量化的-自动编码器设计. 一个 ViT 编码器地图,每个16×16 16\times 16像素补丁为5个5维潜在向量. Finmite-scalar 将这个向量量化为 15,360 15{,} 360 个可能的密码词之一 。 一个扩散解码器从产生的离散符号重建出图像. 对于每个场景,196个196个被量化的潜在向量组成了5×14×14 5\times 14\times 14 lator,在下游分析使用前被平整. 相对于原始输入,在存储被量化的潜在值时,这给出了大约102×102\的压缩系数,在存储每个补丁一个16位符号索引时给出了1024×1024\\的压缩系数. 每个令牌指数都独有地识别出相应的被量化的潜在向量.

blocks.en: TerraMind embeddings Unlike the unimodal tokenizer, the TerraMind encoder is pretrained jointly across multiple co-aligned EO modalities to learn cross-modal relationships. It uses a Vision Transformer that embeds each 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixel patch and processes the resulting sequence of patch tokens. This produces a representation of shape N patch × D N_{\mathrm{patch}}\times D , where N patch = 196 N_{\mathrm{patch}}=196 and D D is the encoder width. TerraMind-Base is used with D = 768 D=768 . To obtain a single embedding per image, the patch tokens are mean-pooled across the spatial dimension, z = 1 N patch ​ ∑ i = 1 N patch h i ∈ ℝ D , z=\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{patch}}}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{\mathrm{patch}}}h_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{D}, (1) where h i h_{i} denotes the token corresponding to patch i i . The resulting vector z z provides a compact scene representation for downstream probing. This pooling is applied only to the TerraMind representations. The tokenizer representations retain their native 5 × 14 × 14 5\times 14\times 14 spatial structure and are flattened into a 980 980 -dimensional vector.
blocks.zh: 地平线嵌入 与单模式的标注器不同,TerraMind编码器通过多种并联的EO模式共同培训,学习跨模式关系. 它使用一个视野变形器来嵌入每个16×16\times 16像素补丁,并处理产生的补丁令牌的序列. 这产生了外形N补丁×D N_{\mathrm{patch}}\times D的表示,其中N补丁=196 N_{\mathrm{patch}}=196和D D为编码器宽. TerraMind-Base的用法为: D=768 D=768. 为了获得每个图像的单一嵌入,补丁符号被平均集合到空间维度,z = 1 N补丁 i = 1 N补丁 h i → R D ,z = frac{1}{ N_{\ mathrm{patch}}}\sum_{i = 1}^{ N_{\ mathrm{patch}}}h_{i}\in\ mathbb{R}^{D}, (1)H i h_{i}表示对应补丁i的符号. 由此产生的向量z z为下游探测提供了紧凑的场景表现. 这种集合仅适用于TerraMind演示. 活化器表示器保留了原生的5×14×14 5\times 14\times 14个空间结构并被平整为980-980维向量.

blocks.en: 3.4 Probing
blocks.zh: 3.4 探测

blocks.en: To evaluate the possibility of embedding-based prediction within MDA, linear and non-linear probing are utilised. Three types of probes are employed: Random Forests [ 7 ] , Support Vector Machines [ 9 ] with polynomial kernels, and one-layer neural networks. Each probing task predicts a single target variable. Where possible, NeuCo-Bench [ 21 ] is also utilised as a standardised framework for linear and non-linear probing of EO embeddings on downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了评价在MDA内嵌入预测的可能性,利用了线性和非线性探测。 采用了三种探针:随机森林[7],支持向量机[9] 有多诺核,以及一层神经网络. 每个探测任务预测一个单一的目标变量. 在可能情况下,NeuCo-Bench[21]还被用作线性和非线性地探测EO嵌入下游任务的标准化框架。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 试验和讨论

blocks.en: The following experiments are organised in order of increasing task difficulty: from detecting vessel presence (Section 4.1 ), to characterising vessel attributes (Section 4.2 ), to precisely localising vessels within the scene (Section 4.3 ). This progression traces how much task-relevant information can be retained and exploited from the compressed latent space as the required granularity increases.
blocks.zh: 组织下列实验是为了增加任务难度:从探测船只的存在(第4.1节),到确定船只的特性(第4.2节),到精确确定船只在现场的位置(第4.3节)。 这一进展可追溯到随着所需颗粒度的增加,可从压缩后的潜在空间保留和利用多少与任务有关的信息。

blocks.en: 4.1 Vessel Detection
blocks.zh: 4.1 船舶探测

blocks.en: For the vessel detection task, a Random Forest (RF) probe was trained on TerraMind embeddings extracted from Sentinel-1 patches, using the AIS-derived labels described in Section 3.1 , to predict a binary vessel / no-vessel target. Hyperparameters were optimised via a randomised search (10 iterations, 3-fold cross-validation, F1-scoring) on a 30% subsample of the training set, resulting in a 500-tree ensemble with a maximum depth of 35, a minimum of 5 samples per split, a minimum of 1 sample per leaf, sqrt feature sampling, and bootstrap aggregation enabled. The final model was trained on the full, class-balanced training set of 75,880 embeddings (37,940 vessel / 37,940 no-vessel) and evaluated on an independent, equally balanced validation set of 18,970 embeddings (9,485 per class). The decision threshold was tuned using Youden’s J statistic (TPR − - FPR) on the ROC curve, to identify the operating point maximising the separation between true and false positive rates.
blocks.zh: 就船只探测任务而言,利用第3.1节所描述的AIS衍生标签,对从哨兵1号补丁中取出的一个TerraMind嵌入物(RF)探测器进行了培训,以预测二进制船只/无活塞目标。 超参数通过随机搜索(10次迭代、3倍交叉验证、F1分)对培训集的30%的子样本进行优化,形成500棵树群,最大深度为35个,每片至少5个样本,每片叶至少1个样本,sqrt特征取样,并启用靴子圈集。 最终的模型接受了75,880个嵌入式(37,940个船/37,940个无活塞)的全班平衡培训,并进行了18,970个嵌入式(每班9,485个)的独立、平衡的鉴定评估。 使用Youden在 ROC 曲线上的J统计(TPR - - - FPR)来调制决定阈值,以确定最大程度区分真正率和假正率的操作点。

blocks.en: The classifier achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.951 (Figure 2 ), confirming strong separability between vessel and background embeddings in latent space. Youden’s J statistic identified an optimal operating point at 46.7%, compared to the default 50% threshold. This shift increased recall for the Vessels class from 78.9% to 84.1%, at the cost of a modest rise in false positive rate from 2.5% to 5.8%.
blocks.zh: 该分类器的ROC-AUC为0.951(图2),证实在潜入空间的容器和背景嵌入物之间有很强的可分性。 Youden的J统计发现最佳操作点为46.7%, 这一转变使船只类别召回率从78.9%增至84.1%,其代价是假正率略有上升,从2.5%增至5.8%。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : ROC curve of the vessel/no-vessel classifier trained on TerraMind embeddings (ROC-AUC = 0.951), showing the default (50%) and Youden’s J-optimised (46.7%) decision thresholds.
blocks.zh: 图2:经过TerraMind嵌入(ROC-AUC=0.951)培训的船/无船分级器的ROC曲线,显示默认值(50%)和Youden的J优化值(46.7%)决定阈值。

blocks.en: At the optimised threshold, the classifier reached 94% precision and 84% recall for the Vessels class, and 86% precision and 94% recall for the No Vessels class, for an overall accuracy of 89% (Table 1 ), with 8,935 true negatives, 550 false positives, 1,511 false negatives, and 7,974 true positives on the validation set.
blocks.zh: 在优化门槛下,分级器达到了94%的精确度和84%的召回率,无船级则达到了86%的精确度和94%的召回率,总体精确度为89%(表1),其中8 935个为正负值,550个为假正值,1 511个为假负值,7 974个为正值。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Classification report of the vessel/no-vessel classifier on TerraMind embeddings (Youden’s J-optimised threshold: 46.7%).
blocks.zh: 表1:TerraMind嵌入物(Youden的J-优化阈值:46.7%)上船只/无活塞分级器的分类报告。

blocks.en: These results indicate that vessel detection can be performed directly within the compressed latent space with high accuracy, without requiring access to the original Sentinel-1 imagery. The balance between precision and recall at the optimised threshold favours capturing a larger share of true vessels at a limited cost in false alarms, which is generally preferable for MDA applications where missed detections have a higher operational cost than a manageable rate of false positives.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,船舶探测可以在压缩后的潜在空间内直接进行,而且精确度很高,而不需要查阅原始的哨兵一号图像。 精确度和最优化阈值的召回之间的平衡有利于在虚假警报中以有限成本捕获更大比例的真正船只,对于MDA应用来说,这通常更可取,因为没有检测到的操作成本高于可控制的虚假阳性率。

blocks.en: Notably, this level of accuracy is achieved on representations that are 100 to 1,000 times smaller than the original Sentinel-1 imagery (Section 2 ), directly addressing the data-gravity bottleneck motivating this study by enabling maritime detection without transmitting or storing full-resolution SAR scenes.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,对于比原始的哨兵一号图像(第2节)小100至1 000倍的表示,这种精确度得到了提高,直接解决了推动这项研究的数据重力瓶颈问题,使海上探测无需传送或储存完全分辨率的搜索和救援场景。

blocks.en: 4.2 Vessel Characterisation
blocks.zh: 4.2 船舶特性

blocks.en: Two experiments were conducted for vessel characterisation: (i) vessel length regression and (ii) vessel AIS type-code classification. To solve these tasks in embedding space, a high degree of semantic information must be preserved in the embedding. Therefore, the smaller downstream dataset was utilised for these experiments to prevent ambiguity caused by scenes containing multiple vessels.
blocks.zh: 进行了两项船舶定型试验:(一) 船舶长度回归和(二) 船舶AIS型号分类。 要在嵌入空间中解决这些任务,必须在嵌入空间中保存高度的语义信息. 因此,利用较小的下游数据集进行这些试验,以防止含有多艘船舶的场景造成模糊不清。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Vessel Length Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 船舶长度预测

blocks.en: For the vessel length task, NeuCo-Bench was utilised to evaluate linear and non-linear probes based on linear neural networks and Support Vector Machines (SVM) [ 9 ] with polynomial kernels. To assess the degree of non-linearity required for the task, the polynomial kernel SVM was employed as the primary probe model, allowing for explicit tuning of model capacity. Vessel length varies substantially depending on the vessel type, as illustrated in Figure 3 . Generally, type 3x vessels are under 100 m, type 7x are broadly distributed with a heavy tail above 150 m, type 8x typically range between 100 m and 300 m, and the remaining types display a bimodal distribution with a primary peak near 60 m and a secondary peak near 300 m.
blocks.zh: 对于船身长度任务,NeuCo-Bench被用来评价线性和非线性探测器,其基础是线性神经网络和具有多诺核的辅助矢量机(SVM)[9]. 为了评估任务所需的非线性程度,采用了多号内核SVM作为主要探测模型,从而可以对模型能力进行明确的调整。 如图3所示,船只长度因船只类型而相差很大。 一般说来,3型舰只低于100米,7型舰只大致分布有重尾于150米以上,8型舰只一般分布在100米至300米之间,其余舰只显示有双向分布,主峰接近60米,次峰接近300米.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Kernel density estimation of the vessel length for the type categories 3x, 7x, 8x and Other – containing all other vessel types.

A dash (-) indicates that no result above R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0 was achievable. Results presented as mean over 20 shuffle-split folds, with standard deviation over the folds in parenthesis.
blocks.zh: 表2:在预测船只长度时嵌入的TerraMind和TerraMind S1标定剂的R 2 R^{2}结果。 一个破折号(-)表示,R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0以上的结果无法实现. 显示的结果平均超过20个洗发分折叠,括号内为折叠上的标准偏差。

blocks.en: The 2D and 3D SVM probes successfully predict vessel length. In Figure 4 , where errors are stratified by vessel length and type, absolute prediction errors increase for longer vessels and those belonging to categories 7x and 8x (which skew larger; Section 4.2.1 ). However, relative error decreases with length: for vessels under 100 m, the median absolute error is 60% of vessel length; for 100–200 m vessels, it falls to 17%; for 200–300 m vessels, it is 18%; and for vessels over 300 m, the median error drops to 14% of total length.
blocks.zh: 2D和3D SVM探测器成功预测出舰只长度. 在图4中,如果误差按船只长度和类型分级,则较长船只和属于7和8类船只的绝对预测误差增加(误差较大;第4.2.1节)。 然而,相对误差随着长度而减少:对于100米以下的船舶,中位绝对误差为船只长度的60%;对于100至200米的船舶,中位绝对误差降至17%;对于200至300米的船舶,中位误差为18%;对于300米以上的船舶,中位误差降至总长度的14%.

blocks.zh: 图4 克内尔密度估计 二维多能SVM的船体长度预测误差. (left)关于船舶长度和(权利)关于船舶类型。 为每个组提供的中位数绝对错误 。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Vessel Type Classification
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 船舶类型分类

blocks.en: To predict AIS vessel types (Table 3 ), a Random Forest classifier was trained using FLAML [ 22 ] on single-vessel patches. Because the curated downstream dataset is highly imbalanced, primary classification results are reported across the three majority classes: 3x, 7x, and 8x. When incorporating a fourth “Other” category or attempting 10-class classification, severe class imbalance caused the model to collapse minority predictions into the three majority classes.
blocks.zh: 为了预测AIS船型(表3),使用FLAML[22]对随机森林分类器进行了关于单管补丁的培训。 由于所编译的下游数据集高度不平衡,因此主要分类结果在3x,7x,和8x这三大类中都有报道. 在纳入第四个“其他”类别或试图进行10类分类时,严重的阶级不平衡导致模型将少数群体的预测崩溃为三大多数类别。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Vessel type distribution in the downstream dataset. In parentheses are the vessel type classes used in the vessel type prediction experiments.
blocks.zh: 表3:下游数据集中的船舶类型分布。 括号内为船型预测实验中使用的船型类别.

blocks.en: The results for TerraMind and the S1 tokenizer of TerraMind are presented in Table 4 , with confusion matrices shown in Figure 5a .
blocks.zh: TerraMind和TerraMind的S1标识器的结果见表4,混淆矩阵见图5a。

blocks.en: Table 4 : 10-fold cross-validation results for vessel type prediction between the 3x, 7x, and 8x classes presented as mean over folds and standard deviation over folds in parenthesis. The indication (W) for F1, precision and recall denotes a weighted metric.
blocks.zh: 表4:括号中3x、7x和8x类别之间船舶类型预测的10倍交叉验证结果,作为平均折叠和标准折叠偏差。 F1的表示(W),精度和召回表示加权度量.

blocks.en: Generally, the TerraMind embeddings perform significantly better compared to the S1 tokenizer. The reason is mainly that the classifier trained on the S1 tokenizer embeddings over-predicts to type 7x. The TerraMind embeddings are considerably more balanced but also overassign samples to the largest of the classes. When splitting the results based on vessel length (Figure 5b ), it was found that the classifier based on TerraMind embeddings in fact classifies roughly given the threshold “vessel length greater or smaller than 100 m”. Given the different vessel length distributions for the classes (Section 4.2.1 ), it cannot be concluded that vessel type identification is achievable further than based on the vessel length.
blocks.zh: 一般来说,TerraMind嵌入器的性能比S1的活化剂要好得多. 原因主要是在S1标致器上被训练的分级器嵌入了7x型的超预想. TerraMind嵌入物的平衡性要大得多,但也将样本过度分配给了最大的类. 在根据船身长度划分结果(图5b)时,发现基于TerraMind嵌入物的分类器实际上大致按照“长度大于或小于100米”的阈值进行分类。 鉴于这些类别的船舶长度分布不同(第4.2.1节),不能得出结论认为,船舶类型的识别比根据船舶长度可以进一步实现。

blocks.zh: (a) 从(左)TerraMind S1标注器和(右)TerraMind嵌入所有船只。

blocks.zh: 图5:(a) TerraMind及其S1引物嵌入器和(b) TerraMind嵌入器在船舶上分出时短而长于100米。 标签名称见表3。

blocks.en: 4.3 Vessel Localisation
blocks.zh: 4.3 船舶定位

blocks.en: The final set of experiments aims to investigate the possibility of localising vessels directly from the embeddings. It relies on two steps: (i) a quadrant prediction task in which a binary classifier was trained to predict whether the vessel is in the upper or lower half of the image and another to predict whether it is on the left or right side; and (ii) predicting the vessel pixel location using the centre point of the bounding box as the target. The experiments were performed using NeuCo-Bench with the same setup as for the vessel length prediction.
blocks.zh: 最后一组实验旨在调查船舶从嵌入物直接定位的可能性。 它依靠两个步骤: (一)一个四象限预测任务,训练一个二进制分级器来预测容器是否位于图像上半部或下半部,另一个则用来预测它是否位于左侧或右侧; (二)以边框的中心点作为目标来预测容器像素位置. 这些实验是使用NeuCo-Bench进行的,其设置与船体长度预测相同。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Quadrant Localisation
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 四方定位

blocks.en: The quadrant prediction experiment constitutes two almost perfectly balanced binary classification problems, due to the uniform location distribution of the vessels within the images.
blocks.zh: 象限预测实验构成了两个几乎完全平衡的二进制分类问题,因为图像内容器的位置分布一致.

blocks.en: The results for the quadrant localisation are given in Table 5 . As with the vessel length prediction experiments, TerraMind embeddings and a 2D or 3D kernel SVM probe generally perform well on this task, achieving F1 scores of 0.76 and accuracy scores of the same magnitude. The S1 tokenizer embeddings slightly outperform TerraMind when using the linear network but perform worse on the SVM probes.
blocks.zh: 四方定位结果见表5。 与船体长度预测实验一样,TerraMind嵌入和一款2D或3D内核SVM探测器在这项任务上一般表现良好,达到F1分0.76分,精度分数相同. S1标致器在使用线性网络时嵌入了略优于TerraMind,但在SVM探测器上表现更差.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Results in F1 score for TerraMind and the TerraMind S1 tokenizer embeddings on predicting the image quadrant containing the vessel. Results presented as mean over 20 shuffle-split folds, with standard deviation over the folds in parenthesis.
blocks.zh: 表5:TerraMind和TerraMind S1标注剂在预测含有容器的图像象限时的F1分数结果。 显示的结果平均超过20个洗发分折叠,括号内为折叠上的标准偏差。

blocks.en: When the vessels are separated by length and type, it was found that short vessels have lower scores, with F1 scores closer to 0.6 for the 2D and 3D SVM models, while the F1-score performance is around 0.8–0.9 for vessels of lengths greater than 100 m. Similarly, the longer 7x and 8x types have F1-scores around 0.85, while the shorter 3x vessels are closer to 0.6 in F1-score. No significant performance dependency on the closeness of the vessel to the classification boundary, i.e., the vertical or horizontal line through the centre pixel, was found.
blocks.zh: 船舶按长度和类型分开时,发现短船分数较低,2D型和3D型SVM型的F1分数更接近0.6分;而长度大于100米的船舶的F1分数性能为0.8-0.9分. 同样地,更长的7×和8×型有F1-分数约0.85分,而较短的3×型舰只更接近F1-分数的0.6分. 没有发现显著的性能依赖容器靠近分类边界,即通过中像素的垂直或水平线.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Pixel Localisation
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 像素本地化

blocks.en: For pixel localisation, the centre point of the bounding box was used as a proxy for the vessel location. Two regression models were trained, the first to predict the horizontal pixel index of the bounding box centre point, and the second to predict the vertical pixel index. The pixel indices were normalised by subtracting the half-width/height of the image and dividing by the full width/height, yielding a target range in approximately [-0.39, 0.39] due to the 30 pixel buffer from the vessel centre point to the image boundary (Section 3.2 ). As with the vessel length and quadrant localisation experiments, NeuCo-Bench was utilised for this experiment.
blocks.zh: 在像素本地化时,将边框的中心点作为容器位置的代用. 两个回归模型接受了训练,第一个预测了边框中心点的水平像素指数,第二个预测了垂直像素指数. 像素指数通过将图像的半宽/高去除并除以全宽/高去除而实现正常化,由于从船体中心点到图像边界的30像素缓冲,使目标范围达到约[-0.39,0.39](第3.2节. 与船身长度和四象限定位实验一样,NeuCo-Bench也被用于这一实验。

blocks.en: The results for the pixel localisation are given in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 像素本地化的结果见表6。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Results in R 2 R^{2} for TerraMind and the TerraMind S1 tokenizer embeddings on predicting pixel location of the vessel centre. A dash (-) indicates that no result above R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0 was achievable. Results presented as mean over 20 shuffle-split folds, with standard deviation over the folds in parenthesis.
blocks.zh: 表6:在预测船体中心的像素位置上嵌入了TerraMind和TerraMind S1等标注剂R 2 R^{2}的结果。 一个破折号(-)表示,R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0以上的结果无法实现. 显示的结果平均超过20个洗发分折叠,括号内为折叠上的标准偏差。

blocks.en: Generally, the pixel index prediction task is difficult for all probes. It was found that the horizontal and vertical prediction performances differ slightly, although they overlap within one standard deviation. When separated by vessel length and type (Figure 6 ), it was found that vessels shorter than 100 m have median errors of 440–480 m, while longer vessels can be predicted down to within 250–370 m, about 10–15% of the image, or within about two 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixel patches.
blocks.zh: 一般来说,像素指数预测任务对于所有探测器来说都是困难的. 发现横向和纵向的预测性能略有不同,虽然在一个标准偏差范围内重叠. 在按船身长度和类型分开(图6)时,发现短于100米的船身有中位误差为440–480米,而较长的船身可被预测到250–370米以内,大约为图像的10–15%,或大约在两个16×16 16\16相间16像素补丁以内.

blocks.en: Although the R 2 R^{2} results are low, such localisation performances can still be valuable as an indication of the location of the vessel at a finer resolution than the quadrant.
blocks.zh: 虽然R 2 R^{2}的结果很低,但这种本地化性能仍然可以很有价值,作为比四角星更细细地分辨出船只位置的标志.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: This work demonstrates that TerraMind embeddings retain features relevant to Maritime Domain Awareness, supporting vessel detection, characterisation, and localisation directly in latent space. The representations achieved compression factors of approximately 100 to 200, rising to over 1,000 with embedding-space quantisation of the TerraMind Sentinel-1 tokenizer. These results support the objectives of Embed2Scale by showing that maritime information can be extracted from compressed representations. For the tasks evaluated, this approach can reduce the volume of full-resolution SAR imagery that needs to be transmitted, stored, and processed, helping to alleviate the data gravity bottleneck in EO-based maritime surveillance. This work also releases a benchmark of 2,010 manually verified single-vessel Sentinel-1 crops with cross-checked AIS metadata, addressing the scarcity of labelled data for vessel-related EO tasks and enabling reproducible evaluation through NeuCo-Bench.
blocks.zh: 这项工作表明,TerraMind嵌入物保留了与海洋领域认识、支持船只探测、特性化和直接在潜在空间定位有关的特征。 这些表述达到了大约100至200个压缩系数,随着TerraMind Sentinel-1的标注器的嵌入-空间化而上升至1 000个以上。 这些结果表明可从压缩表述中取出海洋信息,从而支持了Embed2规模的目标. 就所评价的任务而言,这种方法可以减少需要传输、储存和处理的全分辨率合成孔径雷达图像的数量,有助于减轻基于地球轨道的海上监视中的数据重力瓶颈。 这项工作还发布了2 010个经人工核查的有AIS元数据的单一渔船哨兵一号作物的基准,解决了与船舶有关的EO任务缺乏标签数据的问题,并通过NeuCo-Bench进行了可复制的评价。

blocks.en: Vessel presence and length were the most reliably inferred properties. A Random Forest probe achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.951 for vessel presence, with 94% precision and 84% recall at the threshold that maximised Youden’s J J . Vessel length estimation reached an R 2 R^{2} of up to 0.74, with lower relative errors for longer vessels. AIS type-code characterisation achieved 62% accuracy for the majority classes (AIS type codes in the 30s, 70s, and 80s), although the predicted types were strongly associated with vessel length. In the tasks for which both representations were evaluated, TerraMind embeddings outperformed the TerraMind Sentinel-1 tokenizer representations, with the largest advantage in characterisation.
blocks.zh: 船舶的存在和长度是最可靠的推断属性。 随机森林探测器在船只存在时达到了0.951的ROC-AUC,精确度达到94%,在最大程度的Youden JJ的阈值上召回了84%。 船只长度估计达到R 2 R^{2},最高可达0.74;较长船只的相对误差较低。 AIS类型代码的字符化实现了多数类的62%的精确度(AIS类型代码在30s,70s和80s),尽管所预测的种类与船只长度有很强的联系. 在评价了两种表示方式的任务中,TerraMind嵌入的表示方式优于TerraMind Sentinel-1的表示方式,在特征化方面具有最大的优势.

blocks.en: Localisation performance depended on the spatial precision required. Quadrant prediction achieved F1 scores of 0.76–0.79, while pixel-level localisation yielded median errors of 250–480 m, depending on vessel size. Performance was generally poorer for smaller vessels across the tasks evaluated. This pattern is consistent with class imbalance and the limited spatial detail available at a Sentinel-1 pixel spacing of 10 m, particularly when the embedding process divides the imagery into 16 × 16 16\times 16 -pixel ( 160 × 160 160\times 160 m) patches and averages their representations. The reported metrics should also be interpreted in light of the AIS-based reference data, which exclude vessels that were not broadcasting AIS at the time of acquisition.
blocks.zh: 定位性能取决于所需的空间精确度。 四方预测达到了F1分0.76–0.79分,而像素级本地化则根据船体大小产生250–480米的中位差. 在所评价的任务中,小型船只的性能一般较差。 这种图案与阶级不平衡和Sentinel-1像素相距为10米的空间细节有限是一致的,特别是嵌入过程将图像分为16×16 16\times 16-像素(160×160\times 160m)补丁并平均表示. 报告的衡量标准也应根据基于人工智能信息系统的参考数据加以解释,该参考数据不包括购置时没有广播人工智能的船舶。

blocks.en: Taken together, the results show that compressed GeoFM embeddings preserve information for vessel presence detection and length estimation, while AIS type-code characterisation and precise localisation remain more challenging. Establishing the operational value of latent-space processing will require a direct comparison with conventional image-based pipelines. Future work will pursue this comparison, including object detection on reconstructed imagery, and will investigate higher-capacity probes for localisation, extend characterisation to the full 10-class AIS taxonomy, and evaluate additional GeoFMs beyond TerraMind.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,结果显示,压缩的GeoFM嵌入物保存了用于船舶存在探测和长度估计的信息,而AIS类型代码的字符化和精确定位仍然更具挑战性. 要确定潜在空间处理的操作价值,就需要直接同传统的以图像为基础的管道进行比较。 今后的工作将进行这种比较,包括在已重建的图像上探测物体,并将调查更高容量的探测器,以便本地化,将字符化扩展至完整的10级AIS分类学,并评价超过TerraMind的其他地缘FM。
